subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should manually uninstalling a plugin referenced by one or more Claws remain warning-only, or must the shared CLI, Gateway, and Control UI uninstall paths require explicit force consent?
rationale: Both policies are technically implementable, but the choice determines operator control, dependent-agent breakage behavior, recovery UX, and the permanent contract consumed by later Claw status, remove, update, and doctor slices.

options.title: Keep Advisory Uninstall
options.body: Preserve warning-only manual uninstall while Claw-managed removal automatically cleans only final, unchanged, exclusively Claw-installed artifacts.

options.title: Require Explicit Force
options.body: Block referenced plugin removal by default and require an explicit override acknowledging that dependent Claws may stop working.

options.title: Defer Shared Plugins
options.body: Pause global plugin ownership in the initial Claw lifecycle and proceed only after the shared removal policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Keep Advisory Uninstall
recommendation.body: Preserve warning-only manual uninstall while Claw-managed removal automatically cleans only final, unchanged, exclusively Claw-installed artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the assigned reviewer who articulated the ownership and removal requirements for this exact RFC stack.
